findings.summary: passthrough assertion is not independent of the value under test
findings.text: follow-on: the assertion at tests/test_a_wait_nobody_declared_is_a_finding.py:129 compares the fixture's own blocker string, handed to the analyser, against the text the finding echoes back, so it holds whatever the ref extraction does and would stay green if _mentioned_section_refs stopped finding refs; the independent assertions beside it at :127 and :128 are what carry this case, so the durability score does not rest on it.

findings.summary: open-section scoping is inert by construction
findings.text: follow-on: the open-section filter at reckon/roadmap.py:1517 cannot exclude anything, because reckon/roadmap.py:3882 unions every run-bearing section into the same set it tests against and every key in paths came from those runs, so the filter admits each key whose plan is in the roadmap scope; a section that is no longer implementable but still carries a run pointer is therefore read as open, which is a precision loss in the finding rather than a wrong pair.
